purpose: Measure source-family reachability and optimized loop-reduction behavior before adding masked-tail semantics.

budget.scope: candidate generation, stratified selection, interpreter and compiled runs, paired warp probes, and result summary
budget.incomplete_run_policy: retain every completed result and report unexecuted cases as incomplete

source_families.loop_carried_reductions: The source loop body reduces evolving %acc_x and %acc_y tensors and uses those reduced values in cross-state updates.
source_families.loop_invariant_reductions: The source loop body reduces %x, %y, or their transformed values; the reducer may hoist these operations. Cases whose only reduction is before the loop are outside this follow-up's source families.
source_families.classification: Classify from SIR before compilation: a body reduction of %acc_x or %acc_y is loop-carried; another body reduction is loop-invariant. Never classify from optimized IR.

selection.ordering: case directory name ascending; select the first 64 in each cell
selection.eligibility: classify from source and manifest before inspecting compiled IR; do not filter by optimizer outcome
selection.candidate_pool_policy: archive every accepted candidate with selected, unselected_accepted, or ineligible status; report a shortfall if any cell has fewer than 64 candidates

paired_warp_controls.selection: within each dtype x source_family x generated_num_warps cell, choose the first four cases by case directory name
paired_warp_controls.classification: pass, unsupported_configuration, resource_limit, environment_unavailable, or correctness/compiler candidate; never blacklist a legal family from a failing probe

execution.reference: independent RefractIR tensor interpreter and stored expected output
execution.optimized_ir: retain TTGIR for every compiled selected case and classify reductions inside versus outside optimized loops

reporting: selected and unselected source-family counts by dtype and generated warp count
optimized retained/hoisted/inconclusive loop-reduction counts by source family
interpret and compiled result counts, failures, and incomplete cases
paired warp-control outcomes and resource/environment classifications
unique source and normalized TTGIR fingerprints as supporting evidence
generation, selection, reference, compilation, and execution costs
